description: Connect your WordPress evidence plugin (optional): its HTTPS endpoint URL and the secret it generated. The secret is stored encrypted, then a signed health check sets the integration state. Without the plugin RepuTend runs on Trustpilot's public signals.

business.description: The business to act on, by its domain (such as example.com), one of those list_businesses shows. Needed only when your accounts track more than one business.

name: set_evidence_endpoint
title: Connect the evidence plugin
